# Protocol-only development dependencies

These XML files are upstream protocol descriptions used to generate development
fixture bindings. They are not covered by rasklad's own MIT grant. The complete
applicable copyright, permission conditions and disclaimers remain in each XML:

- `hyprland-toplevel-mapping-v1.xml`: Copyright 2025 WhySoBad; three-clause
  BSD-style terms, including notice retention and non-endorsement.
- `wlr-foreign-toplevel-management-unstable-v1.xml`: Copyright 2018 Ilia Bozhinov;
  permission notice and disclaimer in the XML, including supporting-documentation
  and publicity conditions.

`sources.json` pins immutable upstream commits and SHA-256. No upstream
compositor implementation was copied. If generated bindings or binaries are
distributed, retain both full upstream notices in the distribution documentation.
This fixture is not currently an approved end-user distribution.
